steps.title: What is changing here?
steps.body: Every NASA variable that applies to this basin is tested. Pick one on the left to see it painted on the land.

steps.title: Is it real, or is it chance?
steps.body: The drop is far bigger than the year-to-year wobble. It is not a straight line either: a wet winter put water back in 2023.

steps.title: Is it the climate?
steps.body: Rainfall here shows no clear trend. Most of the loss comes from what we take out, not from what the sky fails to send.

narrative: Seven states hold rights to more water than the river carries. A warmer atmosphere takes its share of the flow. The rest of the gap is us.
caveats: One wet year does not undo a two-decade decline.
The leftover share is a clue, not proof of who is responsible.
